machine=avocado-raspberrypi4
initramfs_file=avocado-image-initramfs-avocado-raspberrypi4.cpio.zst
kernel_file=Image

stderr=serial,vidconsole
stdin=serial,usbkbd
stdout=serial,vidconsole
serial#=1000000088c98f3b

fdt_addr=2eff2000
fdt_addr_r=0x02600000
fdt_high=ffffffffffffffff

initrd_high=ffffffffffffffff
kernel_addr_r=0x00080000
ramdisk_addr_r=0x02700000

devtype=mmc
devnum=0
bootpart=1

# Calculate partition based on avocado_boot_slot
avocado_boot_init=\
  if test -n "${avocado_boot_slot}"; then\
    if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "a"; then\
      echo "Booting A";\
      setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p2;\
    else\
      if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "b"; then\
        echo "Booting B";\
        setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p3;\
      else\
        if test "${avocado_boot_slot}" = "r"; then\
          echo "Booting Recovery";\
          setenv rootdev;\
        else\
          echo "avocado_boot_slot=${avocado_boot_slot} invalid";\
          echo "Booting Recovery";\
          setenv rootdev;\
        fi;\
      fi;\
    fi;\
  else\
    echo "avocado_boot_slot undefined";\
    echo "Booting A";\
    setenv rootdev /dev/mmcblk0p2;\
  fi;\
  fdt addr ${fdt_addr} && fdt get value bootargs /chosen bootargs;\
  if test -n "${rootdev}"; then\
    setenv bootargs "${bootargs} root=${rootdev} rootwait";\
  else\
    setenv bootargs "${bootargs} rootwait";\
  fi;

load_image=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${kernel_addr_r} ${kernel_file}
load_initramfs=load ${devtype} ${devnum}:${bootpart} ${ramdisk_addr_r} ${initramfs_file}
avocado_boot=booti ${kernel_addr_r} ${ramdisk_addr_r}:${filesize} ${fdt_addr};

bootcmd=run avocado_boot_init load_image load_initramfs avocado_boot
